entries.german: Peter von Rosenberg, obrister Kammerer in Böhmen, urkundet, dass er den Markt Haslach, welchen er dem Bisehofe Albrecht von Passau verkaufte, von demselben um 1300 Pfund Passauer Münze wieder erworben habe und zwar nach deutschem Lehenrecht.
entries.english: Peter von Rosenberg, chief chamberer in Bohemia, certifies that he has repurchased the market town of Haslach, which he had sold to Bishop Albert of Passau, from him for 1300 pounds of Passau coinage, under German feudal law.
